trust_decision.summary: Whether the client-supplied Host header may become the host of absolute URLs placed in emails (password reset / account creation / token opt-in/out links). At the pinned commit it is only checked in LSHttpRequest::getHostInfo against an optional, empty-by-default allowedHosts config, and PasswordManagement deliberately bypasses publicurl, so reset links carry the request Host.

landing_point.why: The summary names password-reset links; sendForgotPasswordEmailLink builds the reset link with Yii::app()->createAbsoluteUrl (Host-derived, publicurl explicitly disabled per the comment at line 167), reached from the unauthenticated forgotpassword action.
